entries.mechanism: For the single 30,000-dollar filer the 2026 pipeline reports 356.25 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 385.00, a -28.75-dollar gap. Arizona applies the same flat 2.5% rate in both years, so the gap is entirely the flat rate on the 2024-to-2026 growth in the conformed federal standard deduction (14,600 single in 2024 to 15,750 in 2026): 0.025 * (15,750 - 14,600) = 28.75. TAXSIM's narrower 2024 standard deduction leaves more taxable income, raising the 2024 tax above the 2026 value; the gap is the indexation vintage, not a pipeline defect.
